in_marathi.name: Arinjay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arinjay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arinjay is a Sanskrit name for a boy. Arin in Sanskrit means 'lightning'. The suffix -jay means 'conqueror'. Hence, Arinjay can be interpreted as 'one who conquers with the power of lightning'.
